about.heading: About Me
about.introductionText: Software developer with **6 years** of professional experience at XTM, a product company building a Translation Management System. I've grown across the stack from **QA** to **backend** to **frontend**, and now specialize in frontend development with **React** and **TypeScript**. I also have hands-on experience with Angular, plain JavaScript, and backend work in **Java 17**, **Spring Boot**, and **MongoDB**. My cross-functional background gives me a deep understanding of the challenges my teammates face, making collaboration faster and more effective. I'm currently looking for frontend or fullstack roles where I can keep building modern, well-architected products.
proudOfText: Built an internal branch management tool (Atlassian Forge + React, Spring Boot + Project Reactor) that automated repository setup - reducing release and development branch creation time from ~1 hour to a few minutes. Covered branch creation, XML/text file configuration, and Jenkinsfile setup across all repositories.
Investigated and rewrote a legacy module to improve accessibility for users with disabilities, following WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) standards.
Developed a fully responsive data table using TanStack Table, supporting drag-and-drop column reordering, sorting, full column resizing, and column locking.
Refactored excessive conditional branching into the Strategy design pattern, reorganizing complex business logic into clean, maintainable action classes.

details: Owned frontend architecture, development, and maintenance for the assigned XTM localization platform area as the sole frontend engineer on a 5-person cross-functional team.
Delivered new React and TypeScript features end-to-end, maintaining high code quality through reusable components, strict typing, and testing.
Modernized legacy AngularJS customer listing module by refactoring them to React, reducing outdated code and improving long-term maintainability.
Leveraged AI-assisted development tools in daily workflows to accelerate delivery and reduce repetitive implementation work.
Presented new features to stakeholders, translating technical details into clear product impact and tradeoffs.
Core engineer on the migration of XTM's tasks and user listing frontend from AngularJS/jQuery to React, TypeScript, and RTK Query, converting legacy views into reusable, typed components.
Co-designed the component architecture for the tasks and user listing module, standardizing tables, filters, pagination, and detail views across the team.

Led development of an internal Jira plugin on Atlassian Forge (React frontend, Java 17 / Spring Boot backend) used by around 150 engineers, automating 200+ workflow steps and integrating 2 external services.
Built a Java service integrated with Jenkins pipelines to automate branch creation and maintenance across 30+ XTM repositories, reducing setup time to only few minutes.
Served as lead developer, owning architecture, implementation, and delivery for both the Jira plugin and Jenkins automation service.
Developed automated API tests using SoapUI and Postman. Ensured quality and regression coverage for the XTM platform.
